description: Which CANOPY locations fit a need, from what's published: team size, area or landmark (e.g. 'near the Ferry Building', 'Montgomery', 'Pac Heights'), workspace type, monthly budget and must-haves. Returns each location's fit (strong, possible or poor) with reasons, the membership that fits and its starting price or 'contact sales', what CANOPY's team should confirm, and the next step. Never picks or reserves a specific office. No contact details needed.
name: match_canopy_workspace
title: Match a team to a CANOPY location
